title: miao miao 2 stopped capturing
symptom: The app stopped capturing glucose data from the MiaoMiao 2 transmitter suddenly. Reinstalling the app and updating to the newest version did not help. After initial calibration, it stopped capturing again.
fix: The user reported that the app worked after calibrating with two results, whereas it usually worked with one.
evidence_quote: Now the app works just had to calibrate with two results. Oddly, it usually worked with one.
